blind_target.title: Studies of similarity
blind_target.evidence_quote: In Study 2 we attempted to replicate Experiment 4 in Tversky and Gati ( 1978 ) which was reported in Tversky ( 1977 ) as the second study providing support for the diagnosticity effect.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Thus, as the meta-analysis indicates, without eliminating possible substitution effects we replicate the original findings by Tversky ( 1977 ) and Tversky and Gati ( 1978 ). However, eliminating substitution effects strongly reduces the observed differences between conditions with averages of 2.89% (1a), 17.5% (1b), −1.21% (2a), and 1.24% (2b). Overall the size of differences between conditions, when substitution effects were eliminated, clustered around zero (see Figure 6 ).
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The authors replicate the original choice pattern but identify substitution as a central confound; the effect disappears overall once that confound is eliminated. This is the paper’s main message, with the explicit joint verdict naming both originals.

prior_decision.quote: In Study 2 we attempted to replicate Experiment 4 in Tversky and Gati ( 1978 ) which was reported in Tversky ( 1977 ) as the second study providing support for the diagnosticity effect.
prior_decision.reason: The source explicitly identifies Study 2 as a replication of Experiment 4 in Tversky and Gati (1978), while the retained shipped original is the distinct Tversky (1977) paper. The reply excludes the 1978 paper because the same experiment was summarized in 1977, but does not settle the codebook rule to enumerate original papers and use the closest actually retested source. Identity/duplicate scope remains unverified after both calls; no third call.

shipped_originals.title_o: Norm theory: Comparing reality to its alternatives.

blind_target.title: Counterfactual thinking and victim compensation: A test of norm theory.
blind_target.evidence_quote: Part 3 is a replication of Experiment 1 from Miller and McFarland (1986) with the robbery-scenario – the study that meant to provide the ﬁrst empirical test of norm theory.
blind_target.outcome_quote: The robbery scenario (Miller & McFarland, 1986) failed to replicate using the original experimental paradigm using a compensation measure, yet we found support for an exceptionality eﬀect using an added measure of perceived regret.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Explicit failure verdict on original compensation finding. Positive perceived-regret finding is an added extension and does not confirm the original compensation result.

blind_target.evidence_quote: To help indicate the overall quality of our replication we included as a positive control an additional experiment with a well-defined effect size. Specifically, we used the retrospective gambler’s task [ 11 ].
blind_target.outcome_quote: Our inability to detect a substantial decline in religious belief was not due to quality issues as we detected an expected effect in an additional positive control study with the same participants ( F (1,963) = 21.2, p < .001, Table 3 ).

shipped_originals.title_o: ‘Mindreading’ Mammals? Attribution of Belief Tasks With Dolphins

blind_target.title: Belief attribution tasks with dolphins: What social minds can reveal about animal rationality.
blind_target.evidence_quote:
When we designed our FBT study, our goal was to replicate the study conducted by Tschudin (2001,
2006) using the same methodology. For this reason, we did not seek to modify or improve the methodology.
blind_target.outcome_quote:
After a total of nine months with over 1000 training and probe trials, the dolphin never achieved the
standard criterion set for acceptable performance (Table 3, Figure 1). Despite all of these trials, trying to train
a concept- naïve dolphin resulted in a failure to demonstrate competency at invisible displacement of a fish in
containers and to provide experimental evidence of ToM using the FBT.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Authors report failed preliminary performance and failed false-belief trials. They critique validity but do not explicitly declare this attempt incapable of adjudication. Both cited Tschudin works are explicitly named as replication targets; Call and Tomasello supplies protocol details and is not a separately retested original.
